question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Trivial
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Minor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"trivial"** means something of little value or importance. (तुच्छ)

 
 
• **Example:** The issue was so trivial that it was not even worth discussing in the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Minor"** refers to something that is lesser in importance, seriousness, or significance. (मामूली)
 
 
• **Example:** He suffered only minor injuries in the accident.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'trivial'** is **'minor'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Minor**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fatal **(घातक): Causing death.

 
 
• **Example:** The accident was fatal, resulting in multiple casualties.
 
 
 
• **Decisive **(निर्णायक): Settling an issue; producing a definite result.
 
 
• **Example:** The battle was decisive in determining the outcome of the war.
 
 
 
• **Formal** (औपचारिक): Following established conventions or requirements.
 
 
• **Example:** The event was a formal gathering, requiring attendees to wear suits and ties.
